message:
`aiProcess_SortByPType` is part of the preset. So the vulnerability is triggered when:
1. A mesh with `mPrimitiveTypes == 0` is encountered
2. At least one mesh was already added to `outMeshes` before it

Now, the key question is: how does a mesh end up with `mPrimitiveTypes == 0`? This happens when a mesh has no faces (or all faces are empty). Let me check how `mPrimitiveTypes` is set during import.

Let me look at how the Collada importer sets `mPrimitiveTypes` for meshes.

<｜｜DSML｜｜unction=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜unction=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -rn "mPrimitiveTypes" code/AssetLib/Collada/ | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜unction>
